description: Time logged. With 'key': that issue's entries — who ('author' the username, 'authorName'), when the work was done ('started'), how long ('seconds', 'timeSpent'), the comment, 'mine' and 'canEdit' — with the issue's total. With 'projectKey' instead: the project's time over a period, as its stats screen's «Time logged» section — total, 'byPerson', 'byWeek' (weeks from Monday) and 'byIssue' (a sub-task's hours counted in its parent: 'ownSeconds' + 'subtaskSeconds'), the first 30 issues named and the rest counted; null when nobody logged time in the period. The period is the last 30 days unless 'from'/'to' (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) say otherwise; an entry counts on the day its work was done.

projectKey.description: Project key, e.g. 'PM', for the project's time over a period.

to.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD; today when left out (project only).
